item.text: The campaign is live with all three approved posts, iOS targeting, and China excluded. It runs from February 8 at 00:00 through February 15 at 00:00 Singapore time, with a $550 total cap and roughly $78.57 daily pacing. X will optimize link clicks; install performance will still need your app reporting.
The first day reported $75.61 spent and 131 link clicks, about $0.58 per click. Costs per click are similar across the three posts, so I’m keeping all three running while more data accumulates.
After two days, reported spend is $155.52 with 270 link clicks. Pacing remains close to plan, and the average cost per click remains about $0.58.

Three days have produced 401 link clicks for $231.65. The practical “Choose three photos” post has the most clicks and a slightly lower cost per click, though the difference is small. I raised daily pacing to $80 to use the remaining budget across the final four days; the $550 total cap remains in place.

Reported spend is $300.16 with 529 link clicks after four days. Delivery is slightly below budget pace, with average cost per click improving to about $0.57. I’m continuing to monitor delivery into the Valentine’s weekend.

Entering the final weekend, the campaign has reported $378.24 spent and 670 link clicks. I adjusted daily pacing to $86 to spread the remaining $171.76 across Saturday and Sunday. All three posts still have similar click costs, so there’s no strong evidence to remove one.

Valentine’s Day has begun in Singapore. Reported spend is $461.03 with 820 link clicks; about $88.97 remains under the total cap. I’ve set today’s pacing to $89 and will check again before the midnight cutoff.
At 4 p.m. Singapore time on Sunday, reported spend is $518.33 with 921 link clicks. The campaign remains within its cap and is scheduled to stop at midnight.
The seven-day flight has ended, and the campaign and ad group are paused. I’ll allow another hour for reporting to update before pulling the recap.

Your campaign ran February 8–14, 2027, Singapore time, and is now stopped.

- **Spend:** $549.94 of $550 USD
- **Impressions:** 1,459,068
- **Link clicks:** 980
- **Average cost per link click:** $0.56

Only your three approved posts ran, targeting iOS worldwide except China. I monitored daily and adjusted pacing.

“Choose three photos” generated the most clicks (489), although click costs were similar across all three posts.

**Completed installs remain unknown:** these are traffic results, not install results. Your app reporting is needed to assess the campaign’s install outcome.
